login.title: Sign in
login.lead: HQ generates and allocates SNs; factories acquire and print by PI. SNs never repeat within a PI.
login.point1: Preview before generating; stale when the max changes
login.point2: Acquire a whole PI per batch, idempotent request no.
login.hint: Accounts are created by the administrator with the company employee number; change the initial password at first sign-in.

password.title: Change password
password.forced: First sign-in or password reset: please change your password first.
password.policy: 8–64 characters with both letters and digits.

orders.title: Production order snapshot
orders.desc: From Kingdee production orders (planned / plan-confirmed only), stored per material line. Left: totals per order; right: material lines. Orders without a customer are hidden.
orders.syncedRemoved: Order {bill} is no longer planned; removed from the snapshot
orders.excluded: {n} more orders without customer are hidden
orders.unmapped: These production orgs are not set up as factories; their orders cannot be generated: {orgs}
orders.pick: Pick an order on the left

generate.title: Generate & allocate
generate.desc: Per production order: preview and generate within the quota (pool status: to allocate), then allocate the whole order to its production org. Orders of the same factory and PI share one serial sequence.
generate.step2: Step 2: allocate to the production org
generate.limitHint: Defaults to 10000 on this page and can be changed; the server has no limit.
generate.startHint: Can be set only once per PI, before its first generation.
generate.startInvalid: Start number must be a positive integer
generate.needPreview: Generation requires a preview of the current inputs; change the quantity or start number and you must preview again.
generate.failed: Generation failed and was rolled back: {msg}
generate.allocHint: {pending} to allocate; defaults to the last generated quantity.
generate.allocFactoryHint: Only the order's production org; all materials of the order go together.
generate.allocConfirm: Allocate {qty} SNs to {factory}? They become to-acquire.

issue.ORDER_NO_CUSTOMER: Order has no customer; cannot generate
issue.ORDER_NO_PI: Order has no PI; cannot generate
issue.FACTORY_UNMAPPED: Production org “{org}” is not a factory yet; sync factories first
issue.RULE_MISSING: No rule: configure a PI, customer or general rule

piInit.title: Start number & history import
piInit.desc: Go-live import: each PI may set a start number once before its first generation and optionally import SNs issued earlier (status printed, included in duplicate checks). Afterwards the start number is locked.
piInit.noRule: No rule (imported SNs cannot be decoded)
piInit.locked: This PI already has a start number or generated SNs (start: {start}).
piInit.startHint: Generation continues from max(start − 1, max imported serial) + 1 without gaps.
piInit.snPlaceholder: One full SN per line, or upload CSV / TXT (first column)
piInit.confirm: PI {pi}: start {start}, import {n} SNs. The start number cannot be changed afterwards. Continue?

rules.title: SN rules
rules.desc: Priority: per PI > per customer > general. Changing prefix, suffix, base, length or charset edits the version in place if unused, otherwise creates a new version; renaming never versions. New versions only affect SNs generated afterwards.
rules.name: Name
rules.charsetHint: Blank = default charset for the base; a custom one must match the base length without repeats.
rules.editUsed: The current version has been used: changing encoding creates a new version; issued SNs keep the old one.
rules.editUnused: The current version is unused and can be edited in place.

acquire.title: Acquire & print
acquire.desc: Whole-PI operations: “Acquire” turns every to-acquire SN of the factory and PI into to-print; “Print” turns every to-print SN into printed and returns the print file. SNs pending transfer are excluded. HQ may act for any factory.
acquire.piAllReadOnly: Read-only: SNs of this PI allocated to all factories; acquire/print disabled.
acquire.queryReadOnly: Viewers can only look; acquire/print disabled.
acquire.printConfirm: Mark all {n} SNs of {factory} · PI {pi} as printed and download the print file?
acquire.printed: {n} SNs printed; downloading the print file
acquire.rule: Acquisition is always a whole PI, never per material or single SN. If a material should not stay here, transfer it first, then acquire the rest.
acquire.segments: Ranges (factory + PI + material + contiguous range + status)

transfer.title: Factory transfer
transfer.desc: SNs that are to-acquire, to-print or printed can move; the source is limited to one PI. A factory request puts SNs into pending; HQ approval moves them to the target (to-acquire there); rejection or withdrawal restores them. Any duplicate full SN in the target PI rejects the whole transfer.
transfer.rule: SNs to allocate or pending transfer cannot move; one open request per SN.
transfer.applyConfirm: The {n} SNs become pending until HQ decides. Target: {factory} · {pi}. Continue?
transfer.approveConfirm: Approve {no} ({n} SNs)? They move to the target as to-acquire.
transfer.rejectConfirm: Reject {no} ({n} SNs)? They return to their previous status.
transfer.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw {no}? SNs return to their previous status.

query.title: SN query
query.desc: Read-only; SNs cannot be moved here. Factories see their own SNs by default and may switch to a read-only view of the same PI across factories.
query.capped: More than {n} results; narrow the filter or export.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.retention: Kept for {days} days; expired months are archived.

users.title: Accounts
users.desc: Accounts use the unique company employee number. Accounts are disabled, never deleted; disabled accounts cannot sign in and their history is kept. New accounts must change the initial password at first sign-in.
users.name: Name
users.firstLogin: Must be changed at first sign-in.

roleHint.admin: HQ: no factory, full permissions, may act for any factory.
roleHint.factory_operator: Must be bound to one factory and can only act for it.
roleHint.query: Read-only; no factory = all factories, bound = that factory only.

users.disableConfirm: Disable {emp} {name}? They can no longer sign in; history is kept.
users.resetPrompt: New initial password for {emp} (must change at next sign-in)
users.resetDone: Password reset; the account must change it at next sign-in

factories.title: Factories
factories.desc: Factories are Kingdee production organizations, matched by name in the order snapshot. Manually entered transfer targets must be existing factories.
factories.name: Name
factories.nameHint: The name must equal the production org name on Kingdee orders to match.
